title: b7z9.24.3: C: wire RPL version change to SFN reset in TDMA
description: Spec R-02a-045/R-02a-022: RPL version change MUST reset SFN relative to new root. tdma.c:111-114 reaches DRIFTING on LICHEN_CCP_EVENT_RPL_VERSION but never resets SFN. Add SFN reset when version changes. The Python/Rust reference: sfn_reset=True flag returned from on_version_change().
